speed_dos.description: Use SPEED DOS BAM on tracks 35-40

dolphin_dos.description: Use DOLPHIN DOS BAM on tracks 35-40

shadow_dir.description: Track number for shadow directory (0 = disabled)

hidden_bam.description: Hidden BAM message (up to 85 chars for D64, 20 for SPEED DOS)

no_modification_without_valid_cbm.description: Only modify image if it is valid CBM DOS format

hash_max_length.description: Hash computation maximum filename length, this must match loader option FILENAME_MAXLENGTH in Krill’s loader. Default is 16.

ignore_hash_collisions.description: Ignore filename hash collisions, without this switch a collision results in an error.

sector_interleave.description: Default sector interleave (D64/D71 only, not for D81)

restore_level.description: Restore level for deleted/formatted files (-1 = disabled, 0-5 = levels)

files.description: List of file entries to write to disk image; each entry corresponds to a group of -w/-f/-T/-P/etc. options in cc1541 order of precedence. Required for practical use.

files.items.items.description: Flattened schema for file entry fields.

files.items.items.filename.description: Filename on disk image; prefix with '#' for PETSCII codes (e.g. '#a0,8,1')

files.items.items.filetype.description: Filetype: PRG, SEQ, USR, REL, DEL, or decimal number 0-255

files.items.items.write_protect.description: Set write protect flag for this file

files.items.items.open_flag.description: Set open flag for this file

files.items.items.numblocks.description: File size in blocks (not for Transwarp files)

files.items.items.loop_only.description: Add directory entry only (track and sector = 0)

files.items.items.force_new.description: Force creation of new directory entry (even if exists)

files.items.items.no_overwrite.description: Do not overwrite if file with same name exists

files.items.items.sector_interleave.description: File-specific sector interleave; defaults to global -S if 0

files.items.items.empty_track_start.description: Start next file on an empty track

files.items.items.single_track.description: Try to fit file on a single track

files.items.items.min_track.description: Restrict blocks to track or higher

files.items.items.first_sector_new_track.description: First sector on new track for next file; negative = aligned + interleave - |value|

files.items.items.use_dir_track.description: Use directory track to store files

files.items.items.free_dir_blocks.description: Directory blocks to leave free when using -t

files.items.items.no_split.description: Do not split files over directory track hole

files.items.items.transwarp_allocation.description: Transwarp allocation strategy: 0 = command order, 1 = save space

files.items.items.transwarp_key.description: Encryption key for Transwarp (up to 29 chars)
